hdrl.name: Video for Windows AVI 1.0 `hdrl` LIST -- the main AVI header and per-stream headers/formats (`avih`/`strh`/`strf`), plus the whole-document set-snapshot/no-mutation surface. The shared RIFF reader/writer for the whole container lives here; the other two subsets reuse it (family-module pattern) rather than duplicating it.

movi.name: Video for Windows AVI 1.0 `movi` LIST -- the interleaved video/audio sample data chunks, normatively distinct from `hdrl`.

idx1.name: Video for Windows AVI 1.0 `idx1` chunk -- the optional index of `movi` chunk offsets/flags/sizes, normatively distinct from both `hdrl` and `movi`.
